prompt: How do you scale a BufferedImage when drawing it?
choices: g.drawImage(img, x, y, newWidth, newHeight, this)
explanation: drawImage(img, x, y, width, height, observer) scales the image to the specified width and height. To scale proportionally: compute the ratio from img.getWidth() and img.getHeight(). For higher quality scaling, use Graphics2D with RenderingHints.VALUE_INTERPOLATION_BILINEAR.
